variants.name: 1 · Summary Banner
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished high-fidelity desktop stats-page mockup for the Roblox game "Get Funded!". Landscape 16:9 full screen screenshot, crisp readable type, no device frame, no perspective, no surrounding presentation board. This is a new PAGE LAYOUT option within the approved POLISHED GAME design system.
Input image roles: Image 1 is the approved Polished Game visual direction, the main style reference. Image 2 is the corresponding built UI kit, a supporting reference for spacing and live-text clarity. Keep that exact friendly game personality: midnight navy background, rich blue panels, tasteful violet gradients, purple selected controls, rounded white headings, yellow "Funded!" brand lettering, mint gains, pink losses, restrained small colorful game navigation icons. Friendly rounded bold display typography, plain legible supporting copy, large aligned numerals. Light one-pixel card edges, smooth 16-20px corners. Use flatter breathing room and elegant hierarchy. Avoid thick outlines, repeated stars, background diamonds, giant gauges, busy decorations, white/light theme, finance-corporate styling. It must clearly feel like a sibling of Polished Game, not a new skin.
Keep all eight game navigation destinations: Trade, Accounts, Shop, Stats selected, Leaderboard, Positions, Review, Learn. Include account picker "$5K Funded #5" and Settings in a sensible navigation area.
Main title "Your Stats" with small subtitle "Your trading performance at a glance".
Compact filters: label "Funded accounts", segmented choices "All", "$5K", "$10K", "$25K" with All selected; scope dropdown "Lifetime · all attempts". Quiet scope context "7 attempts · 6 blown · Includes restarts".
Preserve these SIX metric labels and exact data:
1. "Total P&L" "-$56,808.75", caption "Closed trades only". This is the most important number.
2. "Trade win rate" "29.27%", supporting text "12 wins / 41 trades".
3. "Avg win / avg loss" "0.45", supporting labeled values "Avg win $1,073.42" and "Avg loss -$2,403.09".
4. "Profit factor" "0.18", supporting labeled values "Gross wins $12,881.00" and "Gross losses -$69,689.75".
5. "Day win rate" "—", supporting text "Needs dated history".
6. "Best day % of total profit" "—", supporting text "Needs dated history".
Do not duplicate any of these primary metrics. Missing values are honest em dashes, not zeros. Use a compact note "Some trades have no dates." and a legible "View dated history" action near the daily metrics. Footer "Closed trades · UTC days · Saved across restarts".
Charts: if a small split bar illustrates trade outcomes, mint occupies 29.27% and pink remainder 70.73%; averages split about 31% mint / 69% pink; gross P&L split about 15.6% mint / 84.4% pink. The ratio "0.18" remains textual, never relabeled as a win percentage. Distinguish bars with labeled numeric values. No invented equity curve, timeline, calendar dates, positive returns, trends, streaks, badges or other metrics.
Every element fully inside canvas, no clipped text, no black text strokes, no external option-number label on the app. This must be structurally DIFFERENT from the original three-by-two equal-card grid. Follow the unique layout brief below precisely.

LAYOUT FORMAT: SUMMARY BANNER.
Keep a narrow conventional LEFT navigation sidebar, about 14% of width, matching the reference.
Main content: title and compact filters at top. Directly below, one wide LOW horizontal purple-gradient hero banner across the full content width, with the Total P&L label and large pink total left-aligned. On the right within this same banner place quiet context "7 attempts" and "41 closed trades", separated by a fine vertical divider. Keep it elegant and short, about one fifth of main content height.
Below the banner: three generous equal BLUE cards in a single row for Trade win rate, Avg win / avg loss, Profit factor. Each has clear number and restrained horizontal bar. Plenty of whitespace.
Below those: ONE slim full-width blue daily-stat strip, with Day win rate and Best day % of total profit arranged side by side, both em dashes. Include one shared little calendar icon and compact dates notice/action at the right or underneath within this strip. Daily stats get less height because unavailable.
This is a strong horizontal stack: wide hero / three cards / shallow daily strip. Do not revert to a 3x2 grid.
